title: Analysis code: Within-embryo pseudobulk reveals chromosome-specific dosage effects in human aneuploid blastocysts
description: Python analysis code for a within-embryo pseudobulk analysis of chromosome-specific dosage effects in 198 human blastocysts (14,082 cells), including the chromosome-mismatch specificity contrast, permutation confirmation, rank-based GSEA, mixed-effects modelling and an MR power calculation. Companion code for the manuscript submitted to Human Reproduction.
